body:
This is my first trip report so please excuse anything I missed. I also want to make sure its clear that this report was partially written a few weeks after the event.
0hr - drop with Sun Drop soda at home
+25min - Possibly some mild psychedelic body stimulation although not the same as you would get from amphetamines.
+1hr - 2CBs sibling definitely comes slowly but consistently, once I definitely recognized the effects it never heavily waned in and out like I remember 2C-B being.
+3hr  Theres minor stomach bloating still after attempting forced throw up. My throat feels a bit swollen but I think that already existed.
+4hr? - Im not quite sure about the time in regards to this, but I took a dimenhydrinate (Dramamine) to try and help with my throat feeling so irritated and swollen (still only slightly swollen). I was also slightly worried about some kind of allergic reaction so I figured taking something might help relieve my worry.
Also I drank 2 cups of strong pour over coffee between the 3-5hr marks. (I drink anywhere from 2-4 cups a day regularly)
+5hr  I think theres some slight time dilation, this is definitely more psychedelic than MDMA and still steadily increasing in its full range of effects. Theres really nice euphoria I want to describe as more of a cross between MDMA and 2CB than one or the other alone. Trails on lights feel good to look at; Im feeling socially able and would invite interaction. I definitely keep thinking about sex, I cant wait for W (my lady) to get home. Music is very appreciated and enhanced it brings elated body feelings. However, I have a constant need to clear throat, which might be from the smoked some dagga I had a bit earlier.
+6.5-7.5hr - Around this time I started feeling more disassociated and my chest was tight and my breathing felt more shallow and difficult. At this point I couldnt tell if it was the high increasing or an allergic reaction to the substance, or an over stimulated nervous system. In any case I had the fear, Ive had seizures in the past and all these symptoms are associated with seizing for me. At this point I decided to text W (shes at work) to see if she minds that I go spend money on ganja to ease my anxiety and chill my body. I was so freaked out at that point about blacking out that I just layer on the floor for a while. Finally I hopped on my skateboard and hopped down to the neighborhood ganja shop, picked up my meds, and came right back home; I didnt even get in the door before I packed a bowl. This immediately helped; I just packed back-to-back bowls for a minute until I felt comfy. WOW did this make the high kick in HARD, it was awesome. The visuals and body euphoria just increased, however I still felt like I had a sumo on my chest so I took some valerian root and laid down with W who was home and chilling with me at this point. During this laying down period I had some +++/++++ trancelike moments with clear out of body visuals (just wow).
***In Retrospect:
I plan on researching 2CBs sibling again, happily too. The only reasons I havent put in another order already are finances and health detox. What I really loved about 2CB that I felt is the same with its BK- counterpart was the erotic sexual feelings and ABILITY. I didnt get to try and have any sexual activity on my trip due to circumstances but I felt as though they would be fantastic. Its the only substance Ive tried besides 2CB & MDMA that provide this specific spectrum of sexual feelings (very open, wanting, giving, explorative, dirty but Im not sure to what extent without actual opportunity).
I look forward to further explorations with this.
Peace Love & Light
